meta.name: testing
meta.description: Testing strategy, test writing, and coverage standards. Use when writing or reviewing tests. Covers unit, integration, property-based, and benchmark tests.

copy.tagline: 编写并整理各类测试,守住代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码时总担心改坏功能,想让测试更省心。
copy.tagline_en: Write and polish tests to keep code reliable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build solid tests without overthinking coverage.

howto.what: 当 Claude 修改或新增代码时，它会为改动配上单元、集成、属性或性能测试，并检查覆盖率是否达标；审查测试时也会按规则给出建议。
howto.when: 当你新建函数/模块、修复 bug、改 API 端点等代码变更时触发；也适用于编写或审查测试时。

say.text: 给这个新函数补个单元测试，文件放 tests/test_utils.py。
say.note: Claude 会按单元测试规范生成测试文件。

say.text: 修复这个 bug 时，先写一个会失败的回归测试。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试，再修复代码。

say.text: 审查这些测试的覆盖率和写法，给出改进建议。
say.note: Claude 会依据覆盖标准和规则逐条检查。

howto.what_en: When Claude modifies or adds code, it creates matching tests (unit, integration, property-based, or performance) and checks coverage targets. When reviewing tests, it gives feedback per the rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create a function/module, fix a bug, change API endpoints, etc., and when writing or reviewing tests.

say_en.text: Write a unit test for this new function and put it in tests/test_utils.py.
say_en.note: Claude will create the test per unit-test rules.

say_en.text: When fixing this bug, first write a regression test that fails.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test first, then fix the bug.

say_en.text: Review these tests for coverage and style, then suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will check against coverage and rules.
